styles.content: .wf-catalog{--wf-accent:#12b8a6;--wf-panel:#fff;--wf-border:#dbe4ea;--wf-text:#102230;--wf-muted:#647482;box-sizing:border-box;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(1rem,3vw,2.5rem);color:var(--wf-text);font-family:var(--wf-font-body,Inter,system-ui,sans-serif)}.wf-catalog *{box-sizing:border-box}.wf-catalog__header{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1.25rem}.wf-catalog__header h1{margin:.2rem 0;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3rem);line-height:1.05}.wf-catalog__eyebrow{margin:0;color:var(--wf-accent);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:var(--wf-button-weight,600);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}.wf-catalog__count,.wf-catalog__status{margin:.35rem 0 0;color:var(--wf-muted)}.wf-catalog__toolbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(14rem,1fr) minmax(11rem,auto) minmax(11rem,auto) auto;gap:.75rem;padding:1rem;background:#f5f8fa;border:1px solid var(--wf-border);border-radius:1rem}.wf-catalog input,.wf-catalog select,.wf-catalog button{min-height:2.75rem;border:1px solid var(--wf-border);border-radius:.7rem;background:#fff;color:var(--wf-text);font:inherit}.wf-catalog input,.wf-catalog select{width:100%;padding:.65rem .8rem}.wf-catalog button{padding:.6rem 1rem;font-weight:var(--wf-button-weight,600);cursor:pointer}.wf-catalog__toolbar>button,.wf-catalog__pagination button[aria-current=true]{border-color:var(--wf-accent);background:var(--wf-accent);color:#062d29}.wf-catalog__view{display:flex;gap:.4rem}.wf-catalog__view button{min-width:2.75rem;padding:.4rem}.wf-catalog__view button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--wf-accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(18,184,166,.25)}.wf-catalog__body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(13rem,17rem) minmax(0,1fr);gap:1.5rem;margin-top:1.5rem}.wf-catalog__filters{display:grid;align-content:start;gap:.75rem}.wf-catalog__filter{border:1px solid var(--wf-border);border-radius:.85rem;background:var(--wf-panel);padding:.85rem}.wf-catalog__filter summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:var(--wf-button-weight,600)}.wf-catalog__filter-list{display:grid;gap:.55rem;margin-top:.75rem}.wf-catalog__filter label{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.55rem;font-size:.9rem}.wf-catalog__filter input{width:1rem;min-height:1rem;margin-top:.15rem}.wf-catalog__filter small{margin-left:auto;color:var(--wf-muted)}.wf-catalog__results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--wf-cols-desktop),minmax(0,1fr));gap:1rem}.wf-product{display:flex;min-width:0;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--wf-border);border-radius:1rem;background:var(--wf-panel);box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(16,34,48,.06)}.wf-product__link{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.wf-product__media{display:block;aspect-ratio:1/1;background:#f1f4f6;overflow:hidden}.wf-catalog[data-image-ratio="1/1"] .wf-product__media{aspect-ratio:1/1}.wf-catalog[data-image-ratio="4/3"] .wf-product__media{aspect-ratio:4/3}.wf-catalog[data-image-ratio="3/4"] .wf-product__media{aspect-ratio:3/4}.wf-product__media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .2s ease}.wf-product:hover .wf-product__media img{transform:scale(1.03)}.wf-product__content{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;padding:1rem}.wf-product__meta{margin:0 0 .35rem;color:var(--wf-muted);font-size:.77rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}.wf-product h2{margin:0;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.35}.wf-product__footer{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:.5rem;margin-top:auto;padding-top:1rem}.wf-product__price{font-size:1.08rem;font-weight:var(--wf-button-weight,600)}.wf-product__stock{color:#197149;font-size:.78rem}.wf-product__stock[data-empty=true]{color:#a63d3d}.wf-catalog[data-layout=list] .wf-catalog__results{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wf-catalog[data-layout=list] .wf-product{display:block}.wf-catalog[data-layout=list] .wf-product__link{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(9rem,15rem) 1fr;height:100%}.wf-catalog[data-layout=list] .wf-product__media{height:100%}.wf-catalog__empty{grid-column:1/-1;padding:3rem 1rem;text-align:center;border:1px dashed var(--wf-border);border-radius:1rem;color:var(--wf-muted)}.wf-catalog__pagination{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.45rem;margin-top:1.5rem}.wf-catalog__pagination button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.wf-catalog__status[data-error=true]{padding:.75rem;border-radius:.65rem;background:#fff2f2;color:#a12626}.wf-visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}@media(max-width:960px){.wf-catalog__results{grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--wf-cols-tablet),minmax(0,1fr))}.wf-catalog__toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.wf-catalog__search{grid-column:1/-1}.wf-catalog__body{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wf-catalog__filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:600px){.wf-catalog{padding:1rem}.wf-catalog__header{align-items:flex-start}.wf-catalog__toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wf-catalog__search{grid-column:auto}.wf-catalog__filters{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wf-catalog__results{grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--wf-cols-mobile),minmax(0,1fr))}.wf-catalog[data-layout=list] .wf-product__link{grid-template-columns:7rem 1fr}.wf-catalog__view{display:none}}.wf-catalog__results{min-height:12rem}.wf-catalog__chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin-top:1rem}.wf-catalog__chips button{min-height:2.25rem;border-radius:999px}.wf-catalog__filters-toggle{display:none}@media(max-width:960px){.wf-catalog__filters-toggle{display:inline-flex}.wf-catalog[data-filters-open="false"] .wf-catalog__filters,.wf-catalog:not([data-filters-open]) .wf-catalog__filters{display:none}.wf-catalog[data-filters-open="true"] .wf-catalog__filters{display:grid}}
